{{Quote|Fire.|Tiaan Jerjerrod giving the trooper orders to fire the Death Star II's superlaser|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Death Star trooper''' served inside the [[Death Star command center|control room]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the early stages of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] this trooper was stationed in the Death Star II's control room at the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser's]] firing station during the Battle of Endor. When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] gave the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] commander, [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] orders to fire the superlaser at will, [[Superlaser Fire Control]] began targeting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ships such as the ''[[Liberty/Legends|Liberty]]'', the ''[[Urjani]]'', and an [[Unidentified MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser|MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser]]. When the superlaser was fully charged, Jerjerrod would give the order to fire, and the trooper would pull a switch, firing the superlaser.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Eventually, he was replaced by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jad Bean/Legends|Jad Bean]], midway through the battle.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Equipment==
The trooper wore the standard [[Imperial Navy Trooper Uniform]] for [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]].<ref name="Episode VI" />
